correctness.rationale: Exact unitary Cayley--Laplace--logarithm conjugacy produces a contraction semigroup on L^2(R). A single common continuous unitary dilation and spectral theorem give every matrix-valued Fourier-transform upper bound. Weakly null packets escaping to minus infinity have uniformly small translation and multiplier errors for bounded s; total-variation tail control gives all finite measures. This proves the matrix essential norm lower bound, and scalar numerical radius and the exact sqrt(5) example follow.

value.rationale: Gives an exact complete norm/essential norm for the natural full convolution measure calculus of a boundary-fixed affine Hardy composition semigroup, including arbitrary complex/singular measures and sharp cancellation, rather than a routine individual-operator estimate. Proves all nonzero averages noncompact and their entire approximation-number profile flat; the three-atom sqrt(5) example is an exact, nontrivial strict improvement over the total-variation bound 3. Motivation from recent work on semigroup functional calculus and subordinated operators.
